name: Personalized Faux Leather Tags
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality faux leather, offering a soft-touch, lightweight, and durable finish.
    - Designed in a slim rectangular tag shape that is flexible yet sturdy for everyday decorative and functional use.
    - Made with a 1mm thickness, giving the tag a sleek and refined appearance without adding bulk.
    - Includes pre-punched holes for easy attachment to handmade items, gifts, accessories, and personal belongings.
    - Comes with matching metal rivet hardware for secure fastening and a polished finished look.
    - Available in 4 color options: Beige, Red, Grey, Brown.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Tag size: 1.9 cm x 7 cm ~ 0.75 x 2.76 in.
    - Metal rivet details:
           +) Cap diameter: 0.8 cm ~ 0.32 in
           +) Post height: 1 cm ~ 0.39 in
           +) Inner post section: 0.3 cm ~ 0.12 in
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - Supports single-sided printing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a decorative label and a personalized identification tag.
    - Designed for use on handmade items, clothing accessories, bags, hats, wallets, gift wrapping, and craft products.
    - Suitable for sewing, knitting, crocheting, branding, and DIY customization projects.
    - The pre-punched holes make the tag easy to attach securely with rivets or other fastening methods.
    - Perfect for adding a professional, stylish, and personalized finishing touch to handmade or custom items.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized accessory for crafters, small business owners, handmade creators, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, holidays, handmade gift packaging, small shop branding, and custom craft projects.
    - Ideal for sewing lovers, crocheters, knitters, DIY enthusiasts, and creative makers.
    - Great for adding names, logos, or meaningful details to handmade gifts and products.
    - A practical and stylish choice for both personal use and small business customization.
    - Adds a neat, elegant, and personal touch to every handmade creation🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Personalized Faux Leather Tags

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
